Before & Afters Specials Memberships Shop Online Menu of Services Book Now Current Specials Book Online Home / Meet Our Providers Meet Our Providers Sarah Chaousis, PA Sarah Chaousis has been a PA since 2006 and has a wealth of knowledge in plastic and reconstructive surgery and medical aesthetics. Sarah is a trained aesthetic injector and offers Botox, dermal fillers, and a variety of other treatments such as the Vbeam laser, TotalFX CO2 laser resurfacing, sclerotherapy, and in-office procedures (earlobe repairs, and skin tag and mole removal). She is also highly skilled in performing biopsies and treating dermatologic conditions. Fun Facts and Info Favorite treatment to perform: Botox and Filler, Co2 laser resurfacing, and in-office procedures like earlobe repairs and mole removal Favorite treatment to receive: Injectables, IPL, or any microneedling treatment! Favorite product(s): ZO Skin Health Daily Power Defense or the ZO Skin Health Pigment Control Program + Hydroquinone What she likes to do in her free time: I love spending time with my two daughters, Reece and Parker, at our camp in central Maine! Fun Fact about her: I have three Frenchies named Pepper, Toast, and Jellybean Patient Reviews ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “I always have a superb experience at Cosmetic Enhancements with Sarah- she’s the best! The skin treatments are luxurious, and my skin always looks refreshed and healthy. Everything is professional and thoughtful from start to finish. Highly recommend.” “I recently had an outstanding experience with a lash lift and tint, and I couldn’t be more pleased. The procedure was expertly done, transforming my lashes into a beautifully lifted, voluminous, and darkened state that looks both natural and striking. Rita’s attention to detail and skill were evident from start to finish, ensuring that every lash was perfectly curled and coated. The entire process was comfortable and efficient, and the ambiance added to the overall positive experience. If you’re considering a lash lift and tint, this service is highly recommended for its exceptional quality and impressive outcomes.” “Sarah is so professional and listens to any concerns I have about my skin. She is my go to for any skin issues or questions I have about staying healthy. So grateful I found this group.” Lisa Prentiss, PA Lisa Prentiss, a physician assistant, has deep roots in Maine, where she grew up and began her healthcare career. She earned her undergraduate degree from the University of New England (then known as Westbrook College) and completed her graduate studies at Duke University’s renowned Physician Assistant program. Lisa’s passion for medicine was sparked early due to a challenging family medical episode. After graduating, she worked 16 years in cardiology at Maine Medical Center and later transitioned to adult inpatient medicine. In 2020, she joined the Cosmetic Enhancement Center, training extensively in lasers, skincare, and tissue tightening procedures. Lisa now specializes in advanced laser treatments and microneedling technologies, helping patients boost their self-confidence. Additionally, she leads the center’s weight and wellness initiative, leveraging her 30 years of internal medicine expertise to provide personalized, concierge-level services focused on patient safety and optimal outcomes. With a comprehensive approach to wellness, Lisa works closely with patients to help them achieve measurable health improvements. Fun Facts and Info Favorite treatment to perform: Treatments like Photodynamic Therapy and VirtueRF for their skin rejuvenation results Favorite treatment to receive: Profound—I love the skin elasticity improvements it offers! Favorite product(s): SkinMedica TNS Advanced+ Serum and HA5 What she likes to do in her free time: Boating, fishing, snowboarding at Saddleback Mountain, and gardening—especially growing vegetables. Fun fact about her: Lisa has traveled the world and even participated in medical missions. She’s also a proud mother of a college athlete, often traveling to track meets to cheer her on! Patient Reviews ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “Lisa, the provider was warm and friendly and answered all my questions. I am confident in her knowledge and expertise and highly recommend her and Cosmetic Enhancement Center of New England.” “Lisa helped to get rid of my Sun spots, thank you!” Natalie Nicols, FNP Natalie Nicols was born and raised in Western Maine. She earned both her Bachelor of Science in Nursing and her Family Nurse Practitioner degree from the University of Maine in Orono. With eight years of nursing experience in family practice, emergency medicine, and perioperative services, she transitioned into aesthetic medicine three years ago to help people feel their best, not just when they’re sick, but every day. Her favorite treatment is Botox for its subtle yet impactful results and the confidence it brings to patients. Fun Facts and Info Favorite treatment to perform: Botox! I love the subtle yet impactful results it offers and how it helps patients feel more confident. Favorite treatment to receive: Botox. I love it for the same reason I love it for my patients, it gives me an refreshed glow that makes me feel more polished and confident. Favorite product(s): I love products that are both effective and easy to use – SkinBetter Science’s Alto Advanced for antioxidant protection and their AlphaRet Overnight Cream for smooth, youthful-looking skin. Colorescience Flex SPF is my must-have for a daily glow with sun protection. What she likes to do in her free time: I’m happiest outdoors, whether it’s hiking, running, skiing, or spending time lakeside. I recently completed the Appalachian Trail with my dad, which was an unforgettable experience. I also love spending time with my family, my husband, and our dog McKinley. Why she loves her work: Aesthetic medicine allows me to blend science and artistry. I love helping people feel confident, empowered, and naturally beautiful while building meaningful connections. Josie Heath, NP Josie brings over seven years of nursing experience, including ICU and travel nursing, to the CEC team. With a strong foundation in patient care and a keen eye for detail, she has trained alongside our expert injectors to refine her technique and elevate her aesthetic practice. Josie blends medical expertise with artistic precision to deliver natural, personalized results that help patients look and feel their best. She loves the balance between science and creativity that aesthetics offers—and the opportunity to connect, educate, and boost her patients’ confidence with every treatment! Fun Facts and Info Favorite treatment to perform: Botox… It’s simple, effective, and creates a natural/refreshed look Favorite treatment to receive: Botox is also my favorite treatment to receive, for the same reasons! Favorite product(s): I enjoy any product with Vitamin C. What she likes to do in her free time: In my free time, I enjoy spending time with my family (especially my niece and nephew!), playing golf and cribbage with my husband, sea glass hunting and reading at the beach. Why she loves her work: I love the balance of science and creativity. Every treatment is an opportunity to connect, educate, and create natural results that boost my patients’ confidence. Patient Reviews ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “Hi! …I had an appt yesterday with Josie for filler and it was by far the best experience I’ve had. She was so knowledgeable, friendly, and I’m not having any bruising or as much swelling as I have in the past. Give that lady a raise! :)” “Josie’s is an “11” and I will definitely will be back” “If you’re looking to get lip filler, book it with Josie!! She was so informative, thorough, and amazing! Completely transformed my lips with .8 of juvaderm.” Catherine Cole, RN Catherine Cole brings over 30 years of nursing experience and over a decade of experience as a master injector to CEC. Her extensive background in plastic surgery and medical aesthetics has shaped her specialization in facial balancing, comprehensive anti-aging treatments, and medical-grade skincare. She’s passionate about staying at the forefront of innovation, and is committed to ongoing education and training. Her practice integrates the latest technologies and techniques, ensuring each treatment plan is tailored to every patients goals and giving them a beautiful and natural result. Fun Facts and Info Favorite treatment to perform: My favorite treatments are Sculptra and full-face rejuvenation with hyaluronic acid dermal fillers. I enjoy enhancing my patients’ natural facial contours, improving their skin quality, and creating beautiful results that look refreshed, yet natural. Favorite treatment to receive: VirtueRF skin tightening is my personal favorite – thanks to its ability to smooth, firm, and rejuvenate the skin while stimulating long-term collagen production! Favorite product(s): I swear by SkinMedica’s TNS Advanced+ Serum and HA5 Hydra Collagen. I recommend these products for supporting the three key building blocks of youthful skin: elastin, collagen, and hyaluronic acid. These products are not only staples in my own skincare routine, but also in my patient treatment plans. What she likes to do in her free time: I enjoy spending time with my French Bulldog, Stan, spoiling my grandbaby, and relaxing at the lake. Why she loves her work: I truly value balance and believe that joy in everyday life is just as important as confidence in your own skin! Fun Fact: One of my favorite rides is my vintage 1930’s Old Town canoe, it’s perfect for my trips up to camp! Highly recommended.” “I had a consult with Catherine Cole. She was very thorough and happy to answer all of my questions. The facility was inviting and extremely professional. I’ll definitely be going back!” Tiffany Nelson, RN Tiffany Nelson has been a registered nurse since 2008 and a licensed aesthetician since 2009, bringing more than 15 years of nursing and aesthetic experience to the Cosmetic Enhancement Center. Before joining CEC, Tiffany spent several years in the plastic surgery and medi-spa industries. She has a wealth of knowledge in injectables, lasers, skincare, and beyond. Fun Facts and Info Favorite treatment to perform: I love Sculptra, doing lips, first-time Botox on a patient and of course, my Botox regulars! Favorite treatment to receive: I love many of our services, Sculptra and VirtueRF are my favorites Favorite product(s): DEJ Eye Cream, ZO Skin Health Daily Power Defense and Exfoliating Polish, SkinMedica AHA/BHA cleanser. What she likes to do in her free time: I love running, boating, fishing, gardening, and spending time with my three children! Why she loves her work: It brings me joy to help make others feel good about themselves. Patient Reviews ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “I had an amazing experience! This is my second time going to Tiffany for lip filler and a lip flip. Tiffany is an absolute pleasure to be around.” “Great experience. Tiffany did an awesome job.💋” “I have been seeing Tiffany RN for Botox, Sculptra and other fillers for about 5 years now. I refuse to go anywhere else and travel from Boston to even get Botox – she is that amazing!” “Tiffany takes the time to listen, view the area together, and ask questions in order to interpret what I am looking for. Thank you!” Beth O’Brien, RN After a transformative summer volunteering in Indian orphanages and supporting women, Beth earned her Nursing degree from Maine College of Health Professions. She began her career as an OR nurse at Dartmouth Hitchcock residency program. When the COVID-19 pandemic reduced surgeries, Beth transitioned to Home Hospice, providing invaluable support to patients and their loved ones during end-of-life journeys. It was during this time that her passion for aesthetics nursing developed, helping patients feel confident and good about themselves, especially in the new era of virtual connections. After several years of travel nursing, Beth is delighted to be back in Maine, serving as a nurse for Hospice of Southern Maine and the team at Cosmetic Enhancement Center. Her favorite treatment is Sculptra, valuing its collagen-building capabilities and the subtle, natural lift it provides. Fun Facts and Info Favorite treatment to perform: Neurotoxins! I love the precision, artistry, and immediate gratification of helping patients look and feel their absolute best. Favorite treatment to receive: Sculptra! I love how it subtly and beautifully restores volume over time. Favorite product(s): ZO Skin Health’s Daily Power Defense What she likes to do in her free time: I enjoy being active and staying busy. Yoga, golf, tennis, mountain biking, and cycle classes are my exercise go-tos. I’m a big foodie and love to cook, but I’m not so groovy on the clean up! I also love traveling with my daughter overseas and immersing in the local culture and people. Why she loves her work: It brings me joy to help make others feel good about themselves. Shirley Millett, M.E. Shirley Millett received her license in medical aesthetics from Catherine Hinds Institute of Esthetics in 1999 and has been practicing in the medical aesthetics industry for more than two decades. Today, she specializes in skin rejuvenation and laser treatments including, but not limited to, Sofwave, Ultherapy, Laser Hair Removal, Laser Tattoo Removal, Microneedling RF, Hair Restoration, and IPL. Fun Facts and Info Favorite treatment to perform: Sofwave, VirtueRF, and FoLix Favorite treatment to receive: Sofwave Favorite product(s): My personal favorites are SkinBetter Science and SkinMedica products. Our variety and quality of medical grade products allow me to help patients with all of their skin care needs. What she likes to do in her free time: I’m passionate about daily exercise to stay healthy. I also love sewing, biking, and ocean kayaking in the summer Why she loves her work: I have been in the aesthetics industry for 25 years and I love that I’m able to help patients love their skin and look their best. Educating my patients about our various services and products is very importation to me and most of all, I enjoy the relationships that I have with my patients. Highly recommend☺️” Danielle Hagemeyer, LE Danielle Hagemeyer graduated from Spa Tech Institute in 2019 and has five years of experience as a licensed aesthetician. Before joining CEC, Danielle worked as an aesthetician in the area and managed her and her husband’s construction business. Danielle sees patients in our Portland location for a variety of aesthetic treatments, including Diamond Glow, Chemical Peels, Dermaplaning, Microneedling with PRP as well as energy treatments including SofWave, FoLix, Pelleve, Laser Hair Removal, Aviclear, PicoWay, VirtueRF, and Body Sculpting. Fun Facts and Info Favorite treatment to perform: I love Diamond Glow and dermaplaning! Favorite treatment to receive: Microneedling Favorite product(s): I really like the Hydrinity Eye Renew Complex, ZO Skin Health Exfoliating Polish, SkinBetter Science Trio and AlphaRet Overnight Cream. What she likes to do in her free time: In my free time, I love being with my husband, our son, and our two golden retrievers. We enjoy spending time outdoors together, whether it’s boating, paddleboarding, or relaxing by Sebago Lake. Why she loves her work: I love helping improve patients’ skin and giving them solutions/providing treatments that truly make a difference. In the past, I’ve struggled with my own acne and skin issues, so I know what it’s like to find something that not only works but improves your confidence and outlook on life. My goal is to help others feel confident in their own skin too! Patient Reviews ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “Danielle was very welcoming and professional. Thank you! She gave me advice and help beyond my expectations.” Rita Juliano, LE Rita Juliano graduated from Emmanuel College in 2019 with a Bachelor of Arts in Communications and Media Studies and has experience in marketing and business management. In 2021, she shifted her passion to focus on skincare and aesthetics and attended the Catherine Hines Institute of Esthetics, where she received her aesthetics license in early 2022. At CEC, Rita provides aesthetic treatments including Diamond Glow, Chemical Peels, dermaplaning, and microneedling with PRP as well as energy treatments including SofWave, FoLix, Pelleve, laser hair removal, and VirtueRF. Fun Facts and Info Favorite treatment to perform: I love performing peels and brow lamination Favorite treatment to receive: Diamond Glow Favorite product(s): ZO Skin Health Exfoliating Polish and SkinBetter Science Trio Rebalancing Moisturizer What she likes to do in her free time: I enjoy spending time with my family in Massachusetts, especially my dog, Franklin. I love boating, walking on the beach in the summer, and skiing in the winter. Italian food is my favorite, and I love trying new restaurants! Why she loves her work: What I love most about my work is witnessing the transformation in people’s confidence – enhancing their natural beauty helps them become more comfortable in their own skin! My favorite patients are those with minimal skincare experience. I’m passionate about educating them on the best products for their skin and creating customized skincare regimens to address their specific concerns. Specializing in body sculpting treatments like Emsella, Cooltone, Emsculpt Neo, and Coolsculpting, Allie is dedicated to helping clients regain confidence and achieve natural, sculpted results. Currently pursuing her nursing degree, Allie is on the path to becoming a Nurse Practitioner and is excited to expand her expertise in the future.
